products.name: Anyword
products.note: Predictive performance AI copy; marketing optimization; data-driven; performance claims

profile_text.body:
Anyword is a company that offers an AI content platform aimed at go-to-market teams focused on marketing performance and brand consistency. The company describes its platform as LLM-agnostic, meaning it works alongside any AI model or application, and adds A/B-tested data and brand context at each step of the content generation process. The company claims its approach produces a 30% lift in business outcomes compared to baseline AI models, and that its content makes AI-generated copy perform 76% better overall.

The platform's headline technical feature is performance prediction, which the company says can accurately determine which of two content variations will perform better, based on audience, business goal, and channel, with 82% accuracy. By comparison, the company states that generic models such as GPT-5 achieve only 52% accuracy on the same task. Additional capabilities include a Content Intelligence tool that compares published content against Anyword's industry-specific A/B test dataset, API access with retrieval-augmented generation support, persona creation, and brand voice training. The company also emphasizes data isolation, stating that customer data is never used to train third-party models.

On the compliance and security side, Anyword states adherence to SOC 2, ISO, GDPR, and HIPAA standards, with access controls including SSO, multi-factor authentication, and role-based permissions. The held facts list one tracked product under the Writing and Editing category, described as a predictive performance AI copy and marketing optimization tool. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company.
